Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`. `period_workday_dates` treated `period_end` (midnight on the 1st of the next month, exclusive) as an inclusive date. For UTC users that counted Oct 1 2026, a Thursday, as a September workday.

It now uses the local date of `period_end - 1µs`. For UTC, September 2026 now gives 22 workdays; a check on 2026-09-15 returned `(45.45, 22)`. Zones behind UTC still end on the last local day of the month, as before.

I couldn't run the test suite: `pytest` isn't installed in this environment's `python3`. I haven't added a test for the new behavior.
